{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only the two channels of interest: email and paid_search
channel_filter = df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])
df_filtered = df[channel_filter]

# Check the distribution of the channel column to confirm both are present
channel_counts = df_filtered['channel'].value_counts()

# Calculate conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract conversion rates
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print("Channel counts:\n", channel_counts)
print("\nConversion rates:\n", conversion_rates)
print("\nDifference (email - paid_search):", difference)"}
